HOME Step by step 1 Talk first Ask your neighbour to reposition it. Involve the RWA or society if needed. 2 Put it in writing A polite letter or notice: what the camera covers and what you're asking for. 3 Gather evidence Photos of the camera's angle, and any footage shared online. 4 Use the right forum The District Magistrate (as the HC directed), a civil suit for injunction, or police if private acts are recorded or shared. 5 Don't touch the camera Damaging it yourself can be a criminal offence. TA K E AWAY Your camera can guard your door, not watch theirs. As cheap cameras spread, these disputes will multiply. Clear state guidelines on where private CCTV may point, as the Kerala High Court urged in 2023, would save neighbours a trip to court. Adv.
